title: Recalled abduction aboard a 50-foot craft and toe implantation

tellings.quote: Um well they um two um uh gray small gray beings uh came into my room and um woke me up and said come outside.

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies what he believes are alien implants, says that in Fillmore, California, 'two small gray beings came into my room and woke me up and said come outside.' He says he recalls being taken aboard a craft about 50 feet across and having something implanted in his toe. He tells it as his own experience, which if true would make him one of the people whose implants he studies.
